purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 810 Kudus (city code 7262); local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
primaryPublisher: Kudus Regency Government; Ministry of Agrarian Affairs and Spatial Planning / National Land Agency (ATR/BPN)
registryBasis: Kudus Regency’s official municipal site documents land-use permitting and coordination with BPN, and the official Kudus local-government news portal records an MoU with Badan Pertanahan Nasional Kabupaten Kudus. This establishes a local land-registration office, but not an open public parcel geometry dataset. The city links tax/PBB and property-asset applications; those personal/account routes were not used.

officialSources.observation: Official Kudus Regency information-office article documents cooperation between the local government and Badan Pertanahan Nasional Kabupaten Kudus; this confirms city/regency-local registry presence, not geometry coverage.

Official Kudus government portal links local land-asset/PBB services and describes land-use procedures requiring BPN certificate validation and land survey/pemetaan. Account/property workflows were not opened or queried.
Official ATR/BPN BHUMI guide says the map is an interactive land/spatial-information platform. It is national in scope and does not itself establish a Kudus-specific vector response.
Official user guide describes parcel layer and searches by NIB/HAK/NIBEL identifiers; no identifier or parcel search was made, and no safe geometry-only response schema was verified.
Official guide describes geospatial layer catalogue and data sources, but no Kudus parcel layer schema was established.
